recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The original search modifier is already present and later spelling alignment is covered by related Jira history; this reconciliation fixes the examples that demonstrate the FHIR-14154 behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-14154 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core search issue for STU3 asking for a standard way to search Patient and other resources by Identifier.type plus Identifier.value when Identifier.system is not known, with the accepted resolution clarifying that the modifier is only allowed for Identifier searches.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git-svn commit b539d978bb489a29e7838c2f80d86c9cd3618da8, '#14154 - search on identifier type', which added the :of-type modifier text and Patient example to source/search.html. Later history retained the modifier; FHIR-33422 fixed the example modifier spelling from identifier:otype to identifier:of-type, and FHIR-36683 aligned the search-modifier-code CodeSystem spelling to of-type.
additional_context: Current source/search.html already defines of-type as a token modifier restricted to Identifier-valued search parameters using [system]|[code]|[value], and the active search modifier CodeSystem uses of-type. A 2022 Zulip implementers thread citing FHIR-14154 confirms the intended use case of searching by identifier type and value when the assigning system is unknown. No Confluence reference search result changed the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html in the of-type section so the Patient examples use JSON CodeableConcept.coding arrays, include the JSON separator before Identifier.system, use XML Coding.code instead of Coding.value, and remove the confusing 'type coding of with' wording.
source_changes: source/search.html: fixed the of-type Patient example JSON/XML snippets and adjacent explanatory wording.

related_jiras.note: Published correction that fixed the original example typo from identifier:otype to identifier:of-type; not decided here because it was already applied.
Published correction aligning the search-modifier-code CodeSystem with the of-type spelling; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Later search modifier/type clarification that includes of-type on token search parameters, but not needed as a separate decision for this seed.
